toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=help_scout. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="help_scout") to create a connection BEFORE executing any help_scout tools.

HELP_SCOUT_DOWNLOAD_ATTACHMENT.description: Tool to download an attachment file from a Help Scout conversation. Use when you need to retrieve the actual file content of an attachment.

attachment_id.description: The unique identifier of the attachment file to download

conversation_id.description: The unique identifier of the conversation containing the attachment

HELP_SCOUT_GET_ATTACHMENT_DATA.description: Tool to retrieve attachment data for a specific attachment. Returns base64-encoded attachment content.

attachment_id.description: The unique identifier of the attachment to retrieve

conversation_id.description: The unique identifier of the conversation containing the attachment

HELP_SCOUT_LIST_THREADS.description: Tool to list all threads for a specific Help Scout conversation. Use when you need to retrieve the complete message history and interactions within a conversation. Threads are sorted by createdAt from newest to oldest by default.
